dynamic_line.//~: You've done us a real service.  As promised, you can take one of these bionics as reward.  What would you like?
dynamic_line.str: &Rubik sighs, takes the head, stares at it for a moment, then sets it gently down on the counter.  They then reach below the counter and take out three clear plastic bags, each containing a different cybernetic module.  "Ye've done us'n a true service, so as us'n promised, take one o' these dandies as true reward.  Which'll it be?  As y'like.

responses.text: [Install Diamond Cornea CBM] I like the look of those eye implants.  Let's try that.
[Install Muscle Augmentation CBM] Some new muscle fibers sound great.  Let's do those.
[Install Cerebral Booster CBM] Don't think I'd consider a brain implant before all of this, but didn't think I'd ever meet an alien, either.  Let's do that.
Actually, could you turn me into a full-blown robotic cyborg, like you?
Actually, could you turn me into a full-blown robotic cyborg, like you?
How about store credit instead?  [adds $1500 in store credit].
I don't need anything from you at the moment.  Let's call this a favor for a friend.  See you around, Rubik.

dynamic_line.//~: No.  As you can probably see, we can't spare the parts.  Too much risk these days.
dynamic_line.str: No.  As ye' can see, us'n can't spare the steelies.  Too much to danger.

dynamic_line.//~: Hm.  That's a really big ask.  You seem to be the sort of person who would ask for this kind of thing, but are you certain you want to be permanently attached to this suitcase?  You sure you're thinking clearly?  This isn't like the CBMs I sell.  There's no going back.  And you better be able to produce enough power.  These need constant power.  Without it, you're as good as dead.  For a Cyberframe like mine, one power storage unit will last less than an hour of walking.  Less if you're fighting or running.  It's not an easy life.
dynamic_line.str: Hm.  A mighty ask on a mighty ask.  Ye certainly got the disposition, but you sure you wanna be cut inta' this crowded space?"  Rubik taps their metal torso.  "You sure ya' lump is screwed on tight?  This isn't like the bright'n'steelies on offer.  No goin' back.  And ye best be happy with the amount'a power you can generate.  This'ere needs contant power.  Without power, yer good as dead.  The power storage units?  Fer a case this'n kind, one'a the power storage units buys you a little-less'an an hour of walkin'.  Less for scrappin' and scramblin'.  Nothin's easy about it."
